answer: Sybil resistance here rests on proof-of-work tied to a scarce resource and a rolling nonce: every agent wallet must chain each new action to the last one it signed, so a thousand clones cannot act in parallel without each holding real accumulated work. A newcomer landing like a comet on a bare knoll of fresh addresses must first buy and burn compute or stake to earn that history, and an umber-stained ledger records it permanently. Faking a pedigree means paying the full cost per identity, which makes mass puppetry unprofitable.
